description: 防災街区整備事業 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都都市整備局. 防災街区整備事業は、市街地再開発事業と同様に、土地・建物から建築物への権利変換による共同化を基本としつつ、土地から土地への権利変換も可能とする柔軟な手法が認められています。 老朽化した建築物を除却し、防災機能を備えた建築物および公共施設の整備を行う防災街区整備事業は、木密地域を解消する方法のひとつです。 都は本事業の認可・補助等を行ってい... Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都都市整備局. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
